thread:
maria_p: Quick prioritization sync — we have two customer-driven asks that overlap but pull different levers: 1) granular programmatic ownership (route-level API keys, programmatic rollouts, admin routes) and 2) richer console onboarding (guided templates, onboarding telemetry, quickstart). Need to decide sequencing + launch criteria. Any initial takes?

alex_eng: I lean API-first for big customers — they can integrate fast, lock down routes, and automate rollouts. Engineering surface is nontrivial though (auth, routing, quota checks).

sam_devex: Console onboarding will probably move PLG numbers faster (lower support, better activation). Also helps tiny teams who won't use APIs at all.

leah_design: Console has bigger UX cross-cut impact (first-run experience, empty states, templates). Risk: scope creep — templates can balloon.

robin_pm: Suggest using a quick RICE-ish lens to compare, but keep it pragmatic: reach = how many orgs benefit in Q1; impact = expected lift in key metric (conversion or ops time); confidence = signal quality; effort = eng + design. Also define clear launch criteria so scope stays bounded.

maria_p: Proposal: (A) Ship a minimal admin API surface (route-level keys + basic rollouts) as an API-first low-risk unblock for enterprise customers, and (B) ship one lightweight console template + telemetry that surfaces the same controls for self-serve. Do both but stagger: API shim first, console template second, run an experiment on conversion / support load. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

alex_eng: Rough engineering estimates: full route keys + rollout infra = 6-8 sprints; minimal admin API (auth + route metadata + docs) = 1 sprint; console template MVP (guided flow + telemetry hook) = 2-3 sprints; polished console (multi-template + i18n + analytics dashboards) = 4+ sprints. So staggered makes sense.

sam_devex: Launch criteria suggestion (compact): API-min: auth + route tests passing; SDK shim + example; docs + one integration test. Console-min: 1 template live; onboarding funnel event captured; support ticket deflection tracked. Experiment goal: >=2% activation lift or 20% fewer onboarding tickets in 30d.

leah_design: For console MVP we must include: clear empty-state, progress indicator, inline help, and 1 accessibility pass. Also preserve a path to 'use API' for advanced users.

robin_pm: Quick RICE back-of-envelope (normalized): Console-min: Reach=5000 (self-serve users), Impact=3 (med), Confidence=0.6, Effort=3 -> score ~3000. API-min: Reach=1200 (enterprise routes), Impact=4, Confidence=0.8, Effort=1 -> score ~3840. Numbers fuzzy but show API-min edges for enterprise-mandated wins, console wins on long tail.

maria_p: Good — seems consensus for staggered approach. Action items: @alex_eng scope and confirm 1-sprint API-min plan by EOD Tue; @leah_design ship console template spec by Thu; @sam_devex instrument funnel metrics + baseline by end of week; I'll draft launch criteria + experiment plan and share in doc.

deploy-bot: Note: staging cluster maintenance window 1804600000 — avoid production cutovers that day.

alex_eng: ack, I'll avoid that window.

sam_devex: I'll post baseline numbers to the doc once I have analytics access.

maria_p: Thanks — we'll reconvene next Tue to lock timeline. :thumbsup:
